intro.title: I'm Sasha
intro.p1: I started out in the music industry — live sound engineer at Fabric London, DJing, and a BA in Music Production & Sound Engineering at Point Blank.
intro.p2: Then I wanted to understand how things actually work. I earned a BSc in Mathematics & Computer Science at Aix-Marseille University (2026) — the first year studied online from London, between night shifts at the club. Along the way: 1st place at the AMU Hackathon 2026 and a published article on the learning mechanics of neural networks.
intro.p3: Today I'm a Master's student in Data, Knowledge & Hybrid Artificial Intelligence (DKAI) at Université Paris-Saclay, aiming for the MVA and a research career in NLP and computer vision. I build things from scratch to understand them — from backpropagation in C to instruments you play in mid-air.

header.title: AI <highlight>Research</highlight> & Engineering.
header.description: Master's student in Data, Knowledge & Hybrid AI at Université Paris-Saclay, headed for NLP & computer vision research. I build things from scratch to understand how they work — neural nets in pure C, semantic search from the linear algebra up.

focus.label: Current_Focus
focus.desc: NLP research intern at LIS (Laboratoire d'Informatique et Systèmes): RAG pipelines and topic modelling over the BnF & INA web archives — extracting themes from large-scale WARC corpora. Next: the MVA master's at ENS Paris-Saclay, then AI research.

lis.desc: RAG pipelines and topic modelling on the BnF & INA web archives — building theme-extraction tooling for terabyte-scale WARC corpora.

micron.desc: Python analysis pipeline for 126 high-resolution 3D dental scans: reproducibility validation with t-tests, Monte Carlo simulation and power analysis, plus a landmark-detection algorithm.

vista.desc: Inventory management system built with Supabase and Node.js, integrated with Shopify.

fabric.desc: From cloakroom attendant to the sound engineering team of one of the world's most storied clubs. The other half of this site.

neural_vision.title: Neural Vision 3D
neural_vision.desc: Interactive 3D neural-network visualizer with real-time MNIST digit recognition. The inference engine is hand-written in NumPy; hidden-layer activations are rendered live in Three.js.

ml_library.title: ML Library in C
ml_library.desc: A neural-network library in pure C: matrix operations, dense layers, ReLU/Sigmoid activations, MSE loss and forward propagation. No dependencies — just C and CMake.

vector_search.title: Vector Search Engine
vector_search.desc: Semantic search engine built from the linear algebra up — BERT sentence embeddings and cosine similarity, FastAPI backend, React frontend.

air_harp.title: Air Harp
air_harp.desc: A computer-vision instrument: MediaPipe hand tracking lets you pluck virtual harp strings suspended in mid-air. Where the two halves of this portfolio meet.

koda_marketplace.title: Koda Marketplace
koda_marketplace.desc: Multi-language marketplace for no-code automations: Stripe Connect split payments, real-time interactions via Pusher, secure delivery with S3 pre-signed URLs, i18n in four languages.
